overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long SMTC Daily ETF (SMTG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Semtech Corporation (SMTC) stock, less fees and expenses. Semtech Corporation manufactures analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, IoT systems, and cloud connectivity solutions for infrastructure, data center, and wireless applications. SMTG was launched on Jun 23, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
